title: The Modern building on the square
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：modern　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 modern 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the athlete wrote of ① a modern building on the square in the programme, and everybody in the stadium said at once that it was ② more modern than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the athlete, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the modern ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most modern building on the square anybody in the stadium had ever seen, or so the programme for September 1943 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too modern to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainer who had come to help; the modern ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a modern method of farming, and said that no trainer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as modern as the method of farming they had once had in the old stadium. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was modern or not, and he said so.

By 1956 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something modern, and nothing besides. The trainer from the next stadium called the whole plan ⑧ quite modern; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the modern ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1959, in the rain, she wrote of another modern building on the square in the same programme, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more modern than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most modern method of farming in the whole stadium, she said in 1961, was the one she could never quite name; the modern ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 现代（前置定语 a modern building on the square：1949 年运动员在秩序册里记下的那件现代的建筑）
B. adj. 现代／新式（比较级 more modern than：文中两处，一处比广场上的现代建筑，一处比预想）
C. adj. 现代／新式（最高级 the most modern：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 现代（表语 too modern to do：母亲觉得它太现代，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 新式（前置定语 a modern method of farming：叔叔把整件事称作一桩新式的耕作方法）
F. adj. 新式（同级比较 as modern as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩新式的耕作方法相比）
G. adj. 新式（后置定语 something modern：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 新式（受程度副词修饰 quite modern：那位陪练的评价）

items.q: a modern building on the square
the most modern building on the square anybody
The most modern method of farming in

answers.why: modern 意为“现代”，1949 年运动员在秩序册里记下的是“一件现代的建筑”，此处作前置定语 a modern building on the square。
modern 意为“现代”，此处用比较级 more modern than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
modern 意为“现代”，秩序册上 九月 那行字说它是体育场里最现代的一件，故用最高级 the most modern building on the square。
modern 意为“现代”，母亲认为这件东西“太现代了，谁也用不上”，too modern to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
modern 意为“新式”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩新式的耕作方法”，此处作前置定语 a modern method of farming。
modern 意为“新式”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩新式的耕作方法一样新式”，同级比较用 as modern as。
modern 意为“新式”，秩序册上那半行字要的是“新式的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something modern。
modern 意为“新式”，邻体育场来的那位陪练认为这套计划“相当新式”，quite 修饰原级 modern。
modern 意为“新式”，1959 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要新式”，故用比较级 more modern than。
modern 意为“新式”，母亲 1961 年说的是“整个体育场里最新式的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most modern method of farming。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1949 年，运动员在秩序册里记下了一件现代的建筑。（a modern building on the square）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更现代。（more modern than …）
母亲觉得它太现代，谁也用不上。（too modern to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩新式的耕作方法。（a modern method of farming）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩新式的耕作方法一样新式。（as modern as …）
到了 1956 年，秩序册上只剩半行字：要的是一件新式的东西。（something modern）
answers: In 1949 the athlete wrote of a modern building on the square in the programme.
Everybody said it was more modern than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too modern to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a modern method of farming.
He said nobody would call it as modern as the method of farming they had once had.
By 1956 the programme asked for nothing but something modern.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 modern 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1949 the athlete wrote of a modern building on the square in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most modern building on the square in the stadium, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too modern to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a modern method of farming, and nobody argued with him.
The trainer from the next stadium called the plan quite modern, and everybody laughed.
The modern ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
